name: Open Skies
summary: Understand points, airline redemption rules and which travel perks come with restrictions.
plainEnglish: Travel cards may earn miles or points that can be used in different ways. Redemption value depends on program rules.
watchOut: Award availability, transfer ratios, blackout policies and annual fees can affect the real value of rewards.
limitations: Fictional program; no actual airline, points valuation or booking benefit is promised.
